invariants.name: immutability_of_occupation
invariants.description: Once a node is marked as occupied by a friend, its assigned friend index never changes throughout the simulation.

invariants.name: synchronized_step_expansion
invariants.description: Friends and Vlad advance by exactly one edge per round in a fixed alternation, preserving the invariant that a friend occupies a node before or at the same round Vlad first reaches it.
